hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Brazil's presidential election runoff concluded with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeating Flávio Bolsonaro, triggering intense legal and political turmoil. Brazilian federal authorities ordered Flávio Bolsonaro to surrender his passports amid money laundering inquiries as Donald Trump publicly declared the election 'rigged,' though Bolsonaro's Liberal Party (PL) ultimately recognized the results.
hotspots.affect: Drama over the democratic transfer of power, judicial clampdowns with passport seizures, and international election fraud allegations drive intense polarising reactions.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen officially launched her 2027 French presidential election campaign during the Rassemblement National congress in Orléans, surrounded by high security and massive protest mobilizations. While polls show Le Pen leading prospective lineups, controversy swirled around party president Jordan Bardella over alleged past anti-Semitic comments and public optics.
hotspots.affect: Triumphant presidential ambition combined with fierce anti-far-right counter-protests and media scrutiny created a tense, highly moralized atmosphere.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox Pact to Control Spanish Senate
hotspots.blurb: Spain's conservative Partido Popular and far-right Vox reached an electoral agreement for upcoming Senate elections, presenting joint candidates and strategic withdrawals across multiple provinces. Left-wing government figures fiercely condemned the deal as the birth of a new far-right bloc, while right-wing media framed it as a necessary strategy to achieve a supermajority and overhaul constitutional bodies.
hotspots.affect: High political stakes and partisan conflict over institutional control of the Spanish Senate spark sharp left-right polarization.

hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump and Vice President J.D. Vance intensified their midterm campaign trail presence with scheduled rallies across Kansas, South Carolina, Michigan, and Montana. The campaign events featured aggressive populist messaging and appeals to base loyalty despite ongoing economic concerns over inflation and gas prices.
hotspots.affect: High affective engagement fueled by campaign rally rhetoric, anti-establishment framing, and grassroots MAGA mobilization ahead of the midterm elections.

hotspots.title: Midterm Election Legal Battles & Voter Roll Controversies
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration and conservative action groups stepped up pre-midterm election integrity efforts, requesting states like Washington to isolate hundreds of ballots from alleged noncitizen voters. Concurrently, Trump announced a $1 million reward for voter fraud convictions while Democratic leaders warned of systematic attempts to influence voter rolls.
hotspots.affect: Sharp rhetoric around election integrity, noncitizen voting fears, and legal actions drive ongoing partisan alarm.
